# React + Vite starter

Requires Node 24 or newer supported by Vite. Run npm ci, then npm run dev. For static hosting run npm run build and publish dist.
Review code and dependency scripts before running them. Installation in QOpenPanel only creates a downloadable scaffold, not a live deployment.
The exported lock records the exact template version.
